glosses: cuff (the end of a pants leg, folded up)

examples.text: Quem enterrou as barras de ouro aqui?
examples.en: Who buried the gold bars here?

examples.text: Tom comprou três barras de sabão ontem.
examples.en: Tom bought three bars of soap yesterday.

examples.text: O Tom comprou uma barra de chocolate.
examples.en: Tom bought a bar of chocolate.

examples.text: Tom dividiu a barra de chocolate com os amigos.
examples.en: Tom shared his chocolate bar with his friend.

examples.text: Quantas barras você consegue fazer, Tom?
examples.en: How many chin-ups can you do, Tom?
